source_evidence: PLAYER EXACT "Ask Cirren to detect magic and identify ritually, while i interact with it trying to bond with whatever it is". At Day290~08:20 V has touched dark silver-veined Heart in Lord Severin's opened reliquary with Lord, Edric Vale, Mara, Cirren and Fenar present, and Lord permits additional qualified gentle handling but retains custody. This V directive authorizes two ritual casts by DM-controlled knowledgeable Cirren and V's ongoing physical touch/intentional attempted nonverbal BOND, not V speech, artifact removal, a weapon attack, V Psychic Whispers/Psi Dice/limited feature, specified special ability, or standard one-hour magic item attunement. Check exact Cirren tracker trackers/csv/cirren/cirren-spells.csv: Detect Magic first-level CONFIRMED IN PLAY and ritual; Identify first-level Knowledge Domain ALWAYS PREPARED and ritual, reusable pearl worth at least100gp confirmed obtained Day144, owl-feather component available via ordinary pouch/holy-focus substitution, no component consumed. Use legal 2014 5e rules: Detect Magic as ritual normal action+10mins (~10m6s), lasts concentration up to10mins. Cirren takes an action to examine the heart's magical aura (within30ft, visible), establishes genuinely magic-imbued object, no discernible school ('if any' under 2014 text), not a merely mundane souvenir. Identify as ritual =1min+10mins=11mins; Cirren physically touches actual Heart continually while casting, in Lord's approved supervised setting and with no opening/failure roll. Casting longer than1 action requires concentration and breaks prior Detect Magic concentration when new ritual starts; no overlapping sustained detect field. Identify reports no presently functioning activatable magic-item property, usable instructions, required attunement, stored charges or currently identifiable spell on Heart. This is not an immunity/fudged override of RAW Identify, which WOULD reveal current conventional magic item features and should do so if they existed; the heart's particular physical workings, creator, 'My child' voice and possible latent historical function have been UNFIXED/OPEN DESIGN in prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md and prep/dm-only/long-arc-two-antagonists-dm-only.md, hence do not invent concealed current abilities, spell-created mechanism, future sure-fire bond or speculative soul. Temporary narrow ruling: magic present but currently no identifiable user-operable properties; cannot learn documentary provenance or creator's identity merely by Identify. No dice for basic spellcasting/mental hope, no additional unchosen V psionic costs, no slot used because both RITUALS and no psi bond feature selected. V keeps contact during ~22mins and attempts to establish mental/empathic bond but receives no new actual audible voice, vision, reborn trigger, attunement or demonstrated reciprocation, only prior accepted ancient mysterious "My child" event as memory. Mara independently notes archival knowledge gap, Cirren explains spells' evidentiary scope, Lord Severin interested but cautious; object not transferred, no cost/curse/trap invented. Time Day290~08:20→08:45 including setup/talk, no new rest/day. V HP48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 free Whispers1/1, attuned Cloak of Protection and Luckstone2/3 slots, +1 ability checks/saving throws incl initiative not AC; Fenar59/59HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40, Cirren51/51HP L1 slots4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3 CD2/2, Mara and 4 horses/coach healthy. V purse429gp1sp6cp, rations21 person-days/feed28 horse-feed animal-days, one sealed PixieDust1, LongRest0/6 after dawn290. V retains Kestrel original orders/proof, Mara Neri interviews and Nightglass scholarly working notes, Fenar six sealed reagents/silver tool, Cirren original Day233 Rethwyn compact. Nightglass original Heart stays in its open reliquary with Lord's supervision, separate ORSAVEN survey request and nonbinding alliance proposal to Lady ELARA have left Hall via Eastwatch first-mile runner with PRIORITY PIGEON forwarding, no actual pigeon release/recipient delivery, no Orsaven map or Elara agreement. Scholarly commission with Coris signed and100gp advance already paid; 300gp document conditional and optional800gp field future, no new reward. Next V can inspect/speak/offer different chosen method or stop touching, Lord's current permitted contact still continues.
